versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the cro-signup-flow skill.
- Provides actionable best practices to optimize user sign-up conversion rates.
- Covers core rules such as minimizing required fields, prioritizing social login, displaying progress indicators, and reducing friction from confirmation emails.
- Includes a quick reference table quantifying expected uplift from each optimization.
- Highlights common mistakes to avoid in sign-up flows.
- Suggests validating changes using AI-simulated user testing via Racoonn.
